the use of crisis or disaster as a resource for advertising argumentation.

, in spite of the paradoxical nature of the use of crises and catastrophes in advertising, they are used to promote the product or service, or to change the consumer's perception of the brand.

crisis and catastrophe in advertising are not only used to make the product or service seem indispensable to solve a problem, but also to challenge the status quo and open up the way to a radical change.
